headline: Clear Monday on the lake — cool dawn, warm afternoon
lede: Monday, October 12 opens with clear skies, a low near 65°F, and a high around 90°F with almost no rain in the forecast. Use the cool dawn on Table Rock or Taneycomo, then slide into A/C and indoor fun when the Strip heats up. Confirm box office before you drive in — Monday showtimes were not freshly re-stamped overnight.

featured.title: Early-fall bite on Table Rock & Taneycomo
featured.where: Table Rock Lake & Lake Taneycomo (from Notch / Indian Point)
featured.why: Clear water near 911 ft and cooling fall temps have bass on points and trout working seams on light generation. Launch early, then verify SWPA flow before you wade (866-494-1993).

plan.title: On the water while it’s cool
plan.detail: Table Rock: topwater and soft plastics on long points before the sun climbs. Taneycomo: marabou jigs, zebra midges, or scuds in low-flow seams — call SWPA 866-494-1993 before wading. Carry-forward bite from Sunday’s scout; re-check gage at the ramp.

plan.title: Shade, pizza, and A/C
plan.detail: Monday restaurant spotlight: Ozark Mountain Pizza on Hwy 265 — easy family stop between the lake and the Strip. Pair with a matinee or museum when the high approaches 90°F. Confirm show times at the box office.

plan.title: Landing fountain or Strip evening
plan.detail: Branson Landing fire-and-water fountain runs on the hour (weather permitting). Or head to the 76 for an evening theatre — lineups shift by day, so confirm tonight’s board before you leave Notch.

indoor.name: WonderWorks Branson
indoor.detail: Upside-down museum on the 76 — real A/C and hands-on science for mixed ages when the afternoon warms.

indoor.name: Ripley’s Believe It or Not!
indoor.detail: Oddities and cool halls on the Strip — a reliable indoor break between lake time and dinner.

indoor.name: Beyond the Lens / Hollywood Wax Museum
indoor.detail: Interactive photo fun and classic wax figures under one Strip roof — confirm hours on arrival.

honesty: Night Editor desk for Monday 2026-10-12. Weather from Open-Meteo (36.6509,-93.3691): high ~90°F, low ~65°F, clear, ~0–1% rain — heat banner off (<95°F). No Monday scout files yet; fishing and lake notes carry from 2026-10-11 USACE/SWPA scout. Shows without a Monday stamp: confirm box office. Restaurant rotation Monday = Ozark Mountain Pizza (no venue-exact guest photo in catalog — magazine will label representational or omit). Farmers market is Tuesday-only — not featured today.
